summary: Built a commented Node.js LlamaIndex recommendation CLI with session memory, DiskANN retrieval, co-purchase reranking, and deterministic ingestion of 20,000 transactions. Connection configuration references environment variables so secrets stay out of files. No database data, indexes, or Azure resources were changed during the build.
how_to_run: Run npm ci. Copy config.example.json to config.json if needed. Set DOCUMENTDB_URI and OPENAI_API_KEY in your shell. Use an existing Azure DocumentDB M30+ cluster, then run npm run ingest, npm run verify, and npm start. For a single recommendation request, run node src/cli.js p0001. README includes session commands and cleanup instructions.
